description: This file defines the IdempotencyTokenMiddleware class used for generating and inserting UUIDv4 tokens into AWS SDK API requests to ensure idempotency of operations. It handles the creation of the middleware, UUID generation, and selection of random byte source functions.

classes.name: IdempotencyTokenMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for automatically filling idempotency token parameters with UUIDv4 in AWS SDK requests.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method that creates a middleware handler function which instantiates the middleware with specified service and optional custom byte generator.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with next handler, service, and byte generator.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware to inject UUID v4 token into commands that require an idempotency token.

methods.name: getUuidV4
methods.description: Generates a UUID v4 string from pseudo-random bytes.

methods.name: findCompatibleRandomSource
methods.description: Determines and returns the appropriate function to generate random bytes, if available.
